edge_api_achievements.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_achievements(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_stats jsonb;
  v_existing text[];
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  -- Match first-request bootstrap without creating a daily assignment.
  with created as (
    insert into public.profiles(id, display_name)
    select p_user_id, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)
      from auth.users u where u.id = p_user_id
    on conflict(id) do nothing returning id
  )
  insert into public.user_topics(user_id, topic_id)
  select created.id, t.id from created cross join public.topics t where t.is_active
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into public.notification_preferences(user_id) values (p_user_id)
  on conflict(user_id) do nothing;
  perform id from public.profiles where id = p_user_id for update;
  if not found then return null; end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(achievement_code), '{}'::text[]) into v_existing
    from public.user_achievements where user_id = p_user_id;
  perform public.edge_api_award_eligible(p_user_id);
  -- Awards discovered on collection are historical reconciliation, not a new tap.
  update public.user_achievements set source = 'history'
   where user_id = p_user_id and not (achievement_code = any(v_existing));
  v_stats := public.edge_api_stats(p_user_id);

  with counts as (
    select 'completed_concepts'::text as metric, count(*)::integer as value
      from public.user_concept_completions where user_id = p_user_id
    union all
    select 'completed_reviews', count(*)::integer from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union all
    select 'weekly_quizzes_completed', count(*)::integer from (
      select quiz_id from public.weekly_quiz_attempts where user_id = p_user_id group by quiz_id
    ) quizzes
    union all
    select 'weekly_perfect_scores', count(*)::integer from (
      select a.quiz_id from public.weekly_quiz_attempts a
      join public.weekly_quizzes q on q.id = a.quiz_id and q.user_id = a.user_id
      where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.correct_count = jsonb_array_length(q.questions)
      group by a.quiz_id
    ) quizzes
    union all
    select 'completed_subtopics', count(*)::integer from (
      select subtopic_id from public.user_subtopic_completions
      where user_id = p_user_id group by subtopic_id
    ) subtopics
  ), rows as (
    select d.*, a.earned_on, a.source, a.seen_at,
      case when d.metric = 'consecutive_days' then (v_stats->>'current')::integer
           else coalesce(c.value, 0) end as progress
      from public.achievement_definitions d
      left join public.user_achievements a
        on a.achievement_code = d.code and a.user_id = p_user_id
      left join counts c on c.metric = d.metric
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'code', code, 'metric', metric, 'threshold', threshold,
    'name', name, 'description', description, 'artwork_key', artwork_key,
    'category', category, 'requirement', requirement,
    'show_progress', show_progress,
    'progress', case when show_progress then least(progress, threshold) else null end,
    'earned_on', earned_on, 'source', source, 'seen_at', seen_at
  ) order by sort_order, code), '[]'::jsonb) into v_items from rows;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'current_streak', (v_stats->>'current')::integer,
    'longest_streak', (v_stats->>'longest')::integer,
    'items', v_items
  );
end
$function$

edge_api_award_eligible.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_award_eligible(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with days as (
    select assigned_for as d from public.daily_assignments
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union
    select assigned_for from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), streak_islands as (
    select d, d - (row_number() over(order by d))::integer as grp from days
  ), streak_facts as (
    select d as earned_on,
           row_number() over(partition by grp order by d)::integer as threshold
      from streak_islands
  ), concept_facts as (
    select completed_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by completed_at, concept_id)::integer as threshold
      from public.user_concept_completions where user_id = p_user_id
  ), review_facts as (
    select completed_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by completed_at, id)::integer as threshold
      from public.daily_reviews where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), quiz_events as (
    select quiz_id, min(attempted_at) as occurred_at
      from public.weekly_quiz_attempts where user_id = p_user_id group by quiz_id
  ), quiz_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, quiz_id)::integer as threshold
      from quiz_events
  ), perfect_events as (
    select a.quiz_id, min(a.attempted_at) as occurred_at
      from public.weekly_quiz_attempts a
      join public.weekly_quizzes q on q.id = a.quiz_id and q.user_id = a.user_id
     where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.correct_count = jsonb_array_length(q.questions)
     group by a.quiz_id
  ), perfect_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, quiz_id)::integer as threshold
      from perfect_events
  ), subtopic_events as (
    select subtopic_id, min(completed_at) as occurred_at
      from public.user_subtopic_completions where user_id = p_user_id group by subtopic_id
  ), subtopic_facts as (
    select occurred_at::date as earned_on,
           row_number() over(order by occurred_at, subtopic_id)::integer as threshold
      from subtopic_events
  ), facts as (
    select 'consecutive_days'::text as metric, threshold, earned_on from streak_facts
    union all select 'completed_concepts', threshold, earned_on from concept_facts
    union all select 'completed_reviews', threshold, earned_on from review_facts
    union all select 'weekly_quizzes_completed', threshold, earned_on from quiz_facts
    union all select 'weekly_perfect_scores', threshold, earned_on from perfect_facts
    union all select 'completed_subtopics', threshold, earned_on from subtopic_facts
  )
  insert into public.user_achievements(user_id, achievement_code, earned_on, source)
  select p_user_id, d.code, f.earned_on,
    case when f.metric in ('consecutive_days', 'completed_concepts') then 'completion'
         when f.metric = 'completed_reviews' then 'review'
         when f.metric in ('weekly_quizzes_completed', 'weekly_perfect_scores') then 'quiz'
         when f.metric = 'completed_subtopics' then 'subtopic' end
    from facts f
    join public.achievement_definitions d on d.metric = f.metric and d.threshold = f.threshold
  on conflict(user_id, achievement_code) do nothing
$function$

edge_api_concept.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_concept(p_user_id uuid, p_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', c.id,
    'slug', c.slug,
    'title', c.title,
    'summary', c.summary,
    'example', c.example,
    'flashcard', c.flashcard,
    'topic_slug', t.slug,
    'topic_name', t.name,
    'subtopic_slug', s.slug,
    'subtopic_name', s.name,
    'like_count', (
      select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
      where ci.concept_id = c.id and ci.liked_at is not null
        and ci.user_id <> p_user_id
    ),
    'content_version', c.content_version,
    'review', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'name', e.registered_name,
        'reviewed_at', e.created_at,
        'content_version', p.content_version
      )
      from public.editorial_publications p
      join public.editorial_revision_events e on e.id = p.approval_id
      where p.concept_id = c.id and p.content_version = c.content_version
        and p.snapshot = to_jsonb(c) - array['created_at', 'published_at', 'status']
        and e.concept_id = c.id and e.action in ('approved', 'attested')
    )
  )
  from public.concepts c
  join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
  join public.subtopics s on s.id = c.subtopic_id
  where c.slug = p_slug and c.status = 'published'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_daily_payload(p_user_id uuid, p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'assigned_for', a.assigned_for, 'assigned_at', a.assigned_at,
    'completed_at', a.completed_at, 'learned', a.completed_at is not null,
    'outside_followed_topics', false,
    'concept', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', c.id, 'slug', c.slug, 'title', c.title, 'summary', c.summary,
      'example', c.example, 'flashcard', c.flashcard,
      'topic_slug', t.slug, 'topic_name', t.name,
      'subtopic_slug', s.slug, 'subtopic_name', s.name,
      'content_version', c.content_version,
      'like_count', (select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
        where ci.concept_id = c.id and ci.liked_at is not null and ci.user_id <> p_user_id),
      'review', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'name', e.registered_name, 'reviewed_at', e.created_at,
        'content_version', pub.content_version)
        from public.editorial_publications pub
        join public.editorial_revision_events e on e.id = pub.approval_id
        where pub.concept_id = c.id and pub.content_version = c.content_version
          and c.status = 'published'
          and pub.snapshot = to_jsonb(c) - array['created_at','published_at','status']
          and e.concept_id = c.id and e.action in ('approved', 'attested'))
    )
  )
    from public.daily_assignments a
    join public.concepts c on c.id = a.concept_id and c.status = 'published'
    join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
    join public.subtopics s on s.id = c.subtopic_id
   where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.assigned_for = p_day
$function$

edge_api_history.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_history(p_user_id uuid, p_before date, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with page as materialized (
    select a.concept_id, a.assigned_for
      from public.daily_assignments a
      join public.concepts c on c.id = a.concept_id and c.status = 'published'
     where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.completed_at is not null
       and (p_before is null or a.assigned_for < p_before)
     order by a.assigned_for desc
     limit p_limit + 1
  ), numbered as (
    select page.*, row_number() over (order by assigned_for desc) as position
      from page
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'concept_slug', c.slug,
        'learned_on', n.assigned_for,
        'title', c.title,
        'topic_name', t.name,
        'like_count', (
          select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
          where ci.concept_id = n.concept_id and ci.liked_at is not null
            and ci.user_id <> p_user_id
        )
      ) order by n.assigned_for desc)
      from numbered n
      join public.concepts c on c.id = n.concept_id
      join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
      where n.position <= p_limit
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next_cursor', case when exists(select 1 from numbered where position > p_limit)
      then (select assigned_for::text from numbered where position = p_limit)
      else null end
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_record_subtopic_completion(p_user_id uuid, p_concept_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with target as (
    select s.id, s.slug as subtopic_slug, s.name as subtopic_name,
           t.slug as topic_slug, t.name as topic_name
      from public.concepts focus
      join public.subtopics s on s.id = focus.subtopic_id and s.is_active
      join public.topics t on t.id = s.topic_id and t.is_active
     where focus.id = p_concept_id
  ), catalog as (
    select target.*, array_agg(c.id order by c.id) as ids, count(*)::integer as available
      from target join public.concepts c on c.subtopic_id = target.id and c.status = 'published'
     group by target.id, target.subtopic_slug, target.subtopic_name,
              target.topic_slug, target.topic_name
  ), covered as (
    select catalog.*, count(done.concept_id)::integer as completed
      from catalog left join public.user_concept_completions done
        on done.user_id = p_user_id and done.concept_id = any(catalog.ids)
     group by catalog.id, catalog.subtopic_slug, catalog.subtopic_name,
              catalog.topic_slug, catalog.topic_name, catalog.ids, catalog.available
  ), inserted as (
    insert into public.user_subtopic_completions
      (user_id, subtopic_id, catalog_signature, catalog_concept_ids)
    select p_user_id, id,
           md5(array_to_string(covered.ids, ',')) ||
             md5('one-concept-subtopic-v1:' || array_to_string(covered.ids, ',')),
           ids from covered where available > 0 and completed = available
    on conflict(user_id, subtopic_id, catalog_signature) do nothing
    returning id, subtopic_id, completed_at
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', inserted.id, 'topic_slug', covered.topic_slug,
    'topic_name', covered.topic_name,
    'subtopic_slug', covered.subtopic_slug,
    'subtopic_name', covered.subtopic_name,
    'completed_at', inserted.completed_at)
    from inserted join covered on covered.id = inserted.subtopic_id
$function$

edge_api_saved.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_saved(p_user_id uuid, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_concept_id uuid, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with page as materialized (
    select i.concept_id, i.saved_at
      from public.concept_interactions i
      join public.concepts c on c.id = i.concept_id and c.status = 'published'
     where i.user_id = p_user_id and i.saved_at is not null
       and (p_before is null or (i.saved_at, i.concept_id) < (p_before, p_concept_id))
     order by i.saved_at desc, i.concept_id desc
     limit p_limit + 1
  ), numbered as (
    select page.*, row_number() over (order by saved_at desc, concept_id desc) as position
      from page
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'concept_slug', c.slug,
        'title', c.title,
        'topic_name', t.name,
        'like_count', (
          select count(*)::integer from public.concept_interactions ci
          where ci.concept_id = n.concept_id and ci.liked_at is not null
            and ci.user_id <> p_user_id
        )
      ) order by n.saved_at desc, n.concept_id desc)
      from numbered n
      join public.concepts c on c.id = n.concept_id
      join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
      where n.position <= p_limit
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next_cursor', case when exists(select 1 from numbered where position > p_limit)
      then (
        select rtrim(translate(replace(encode(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(
          to_char(n.saved_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+00:00',
          n.concept_id::text
        )::text, 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '+/', '-_'), '=')
        from numbered n where n.position = p_limit
      )
      else null end
  )
$function$

edge_api_set_notifications.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_set_notifications(p_user_id uuid, p_enabled boolean, p_weekly boolean, p_times text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_times time[];
begin
  if p_enabled is null or p_times is null or cardinality(p_times) not between 1 and 3
     or exists (
       select 1 from unnest(p_times) value
       where value is null or value !~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
     ) then
    raise exception 'Invalid notification preferences';
  end if;
  select array_agg(distinct value::time order by value::time) into v_times
  from unnest(p_times) value;
  update public.notification_preferences
     set enabled = p_enabled,
         weekly_quiz_enabled = coalesce(p_weekly, weekly_quiz_enabled),
         reminder_times = v_times
   where user_id = p_user_id;
  return public.edge_api_notifications(p_user_id);
end
$function$

edge_api_signal_supply.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_signal_supply(p_user_id uuid, p_topic_id uuid, p_low integer, p_reserve integer, p_active_days integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with inventory as (
    select count(*)::integer as published,
      count(*) filter (where exists (
        select 1 from public.daily_assignments a
         where a.user_id = p_user_id and a.concept_id = c.id
      ))::integer as assigned
      from public.concepts c
      join public.topics t on t.id = c.topic_id
      join public.subtopics s on s.id = c.subtopic_id and s.is_active
     where c.topic_id = p_topic_id and c.status = 'published' and t.is_active
  )
  insert into public.content_supply_targets(topic_id, target_count, expires_at)
  select p_topic_id, assigned + p_reserve, now() + make_interval(days => p_active_days)
    from inventory where published - assigned <= p_low
      and exists(select 1 from public.topics where id = p_topic_id and is_active)
  on conflict(topic_id) do update set
    target_count = greatest(
      case when content_supply_targets.expires_at > now()
        then content_supply_targets.target_count else 0 end,
      excluded.target_count),
    requested_at = now(), expires_at = excluded.expires_at
$function$

edge_api_stats.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_stats(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with user_day as (
    select (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today
    from public.profiles where id = p_user_id
  ), days as (
    select assigned_for as d from public.daily_assignments
    where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    union
    select assigned_for from public.daily_reviews
    where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
  ), grouped as (
    select d, d - (row_number() over (order by d))::int as grp from days
  ), runs as (
    select grp, count(*)::int as len, max(d) as ends_on
    from grouped group by grp
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'current', coalesce((
      select len from runs where ends_on in (user_day.today, user_day.today - 1)
      order by ends_on desc limit 1
    ), 0),
    'longest', coalesce((select max(len) from runs), 0),
    'total_learned', (
      select count(*)::int from public.daily_assignments
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    ),
    'total_reviews', (
      select count(*)::int from public.daily_reviews
      where user_id = p_user_id and completed_at is not null
    )
  )
  from user_day
$function$

edge_api_subtopic_progress.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_subtopic_progress(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with catalog as (
    select t.slug as topic_slug, t.name as topic_name,
           s.id as subtopic_id, s.slug as subtopic_slug, s.name as subtopic_name,
           array_agg(c.id order by c.id) as ids, count(*)::integer as available
      from public.topics t
      join public.subtopics s on s.topic_id = t.id and s.is_active
      join public.concepts c on c.subtopic_id = s.id and c.status = 'published'
     where t.is_active
     group by t.slug, t.name, s.id, s.slug, s.name
  ), progress as (
    select catalog.*, count(done.concept_id)::integer as completed_concepts
      from catalog
      left join public.user_concept_completions done
        on done.user_id = p_user_id and done.concept_id = any(catalog.ids)
     group by catalog.topic_slug, catalog.topic_name, catalog.subtopic_id,
              catalog.subtopic_slug, catalog.subtopic_name, catalog.ids, catalog.available
  ), resolved as (
    select progress.*,
           (select event.id from public.user_subtopic_completions event
             where event.user_id = p_user_id and event.subtopic_id = progress.subtopic_id
               and event.catalog_signature =
                 md5(array_to_string(progress.ids, ',')) ||
                 md5('one-concept-subtopic-v1:' || array_to_string(progress.ids, ','))
           ) as completion_id
      from progress
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('items', coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'topic_slug', topic_slug, 'topic_name', topic_name,
      'subtopic_slug', subtopic_slug, 'subtopic_name', subtopic_name,
      'completed_concepts', completed_concepts, 'available_concepts', available,
      'completed', completion_id is not null, 'completion_id', completion_id
    ) order by topic_name, subtopic_name
  ), '[]'::jsonb))
    from resolved
$function$

edge_api_topics.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edge_api_topics(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(topic_row) - 'sort_order'
                            order by topic_row.sort_order, topic_row.name), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.sort_order,
           count(c.id) filter (where c.status = 'published')::integer as concept_count,
           exists (
             select 1 from public.user_topics ut
             where ut.user_id = p_user_id and ut.topic_id = t.id
           ) as following
      from public.topics t
      left join public.concepts c on c.topic_id = t.id
     where t.is_active
     group by t.id, t.slug, t.name, t.description, t.sort_order
  ) topic_row
$function$

enqueue_editorial_notification.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_editorial_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.assigned_to is not null and new.review_assigned_at is not null
     and new.status in ('draft','pending_review') then
    insert into public.editorial_notification_outbox(revision_id,recipient_id,epoch,ordinal)
      values(new.id,new.assigned_to,new.notification_epoch,0) on conflict do nothing;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

handle_new_user.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', split_part(new.email, '@', 1))
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.notification_preferences (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  -- Follow every active topic by default, matching the app's current behaviour.
  insert into public.user_topics (user_id, topic_id)
  select new.id, t.id from public.topics t where t.is_active
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

protect_reviewed_revision_body.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_reviewed_revision_body()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  if (new.body,new.concept_id,new.base_version) is distinct from
     (old.body,old.concept_id,old.base_version)
     and exists(select 1 from public.editorial_revision_events where revision_id=old.id) then
    raise exception 'Reviewed revisions are immutable; create a new revision';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
